crossRefs.note: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on…
“Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves.
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled…
Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful…
Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…

translations.web: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
translations.bsb: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
translations.kjv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
translations.asv: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
